# TravelTracker repository instructions

- Target .NET 10 with nullable reference types enabled. Read `README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, the relevant `docs/` contracts, and source before changing behavior.
- Keep the existing `TravelTracker.Api`, `TravelTracker.Data`, and `TravelTracker.Domain` responsibilities. `src/Database/schema.sql` is an existing schema; it is not evidence that EF Core or all planned features are implemented.
- Keep one primary production type/resource responsibility per file; group cohesive resource operations and keep Program.cs focused on composition. The original single-host LAB_07 demo, its port, resource list, test layout and 30-case cap are historical conventions, not permanent course architecture. Inspect current files; preserve the layout for scoped features, but honor explicitly requested SOA/milestone work. Independently runnable services need their own ownership, contracts and verification; do not claim a single-host demo meets that requirement. See the canonical skills for details.
- Use `/** ... */` documentation with `@param` and `@return` for new/substantially changed member documentation. Preserve unrelated existing comments.
- For feature implementation, refactoring, architecture, or comments, read and use [code](skills/code/SKILL.md).
- For adding/updating/running/investigating tests or validating behavior changes, read and use [testing](skills/testing/SKILL.md).
- For validating a change before commit/push/PR, read and use [validation](skills/validation/SKILL.md). For committing use [commit](skills/commit/SKILL.md); for rebase/push/PR/merge use [merge](skills/merge/SKILL.md). For planning features from `docs/` use [planning](skills/planning/SKILL.md); for creating small INVEST-style GitHub issues use [issues](skills/issues/SKILL.md).
- Never force push, including `--force-with-lease`; ask the human to push a rebased branch.
- Follow the product's ownership/privacy rules. Keep credentials and personal data out of source and logs.
- For the implemented API, run `dotnet test TravelTracker.Tests.slnx --configuration Release`. Test hosts start automatically. The full solution now builds after the minimal Id64/type-declaration fixes; its normal checks, from the repository root, are `dotnet restore TravelTracker.slnx`, `dotnet build TravelTracker.slnx --configuration Release --no-restore`, then `dotnet test TravelTracker.slnx --configuration Release --no-build --no-restore` when test projects exist. Report discovered test counts accurately. Trip/TripLeg/UserSettings/TripMapPoint are empty partial type declarations, not implemented features.
- Follow `CONTRIBUTING.md` for branch/PR work; an explicitly requested branch name takes precedence over its naming recommendation. A task request determines whether to commit, push, or open a PR.
- Current lecture mapping and a link to the historical setup baseline are recorded in [skills-sources.md](../docs/skills-sources.md); recheck changing facts against current files.
